task_1.name: Wire circuit breaker + deadlock detector into coordinator_hub.py
task_1.details: Found that Wave 3 (or an intermediate wave) already wired circuit_breaker and deadlock_detector into CoordinatorDashboard. The class already accepts optional circuit_breaker and deadlock_detector parameters, has run_health_checks() that calls deadlock_detector.scan_all() and circuit_breaker.get_all_circuits(), includes start_health_monitor()/stop_health_monitor() background thread, and integrates health checks into the close() lifecycle. No additional changes needed.

task_2.name: Wire escalation timers into multi_team_runner.py
task_2.details: Wave 3 partially wired escalation: import and init_environment() creation of EscalationTimerManager were present. Quebec wired the remaining pieces: (1) _manage_escalation_timers() method that creates BLOCKER_ESCALATION timers for blocked agents and IDLE_AGENT_REASSIGNMENT timers for completed agents, with dedup tracking and auto-cancellation when state changes; (2) clean shutdown of escalation manager in stop(); (3) --enable-escalation/--disable-escalation CLI flags.
changes: Added escalation manager close() in stop() method
Wired CLI flag into config via args.enable_escalation

task_3.name: Wire capability + load balancer into help_protocol.py
task_3.details: Added optional capability_registry (CapabilityRegistry) and load_balancer (LoadBalancer) parameters to HelpProtocol. Wired into three methods: (1) auto_assign_idle_teams() uses match_work_to_team() for capability-based assignment when registry available, with load_balancer.get_least_loaded() for tie-breaking; (2) offer_help() updates load_balancer when team takes on work; (3) fulfill_help() calls load_balancer.record_completion() when work is done. Full backwards compatibility maintained -- all new params are optional with None defaults.
changes: Added TYPE_CHECKING imports for CapabilityRegistry and LoadBalancer
Added capability_registry and load_balancer optional params to __init__
Updated auto_assign_idle_teams() with capability registry matching and load balancer tie-breaking
Updated offer_help() with load_balancer.update_load() after accepting work
Updated fulfill_help() with load_balancer.record_completion() after completing work
Updated auto_assign_idle_teams() auto-assignment loop with load_balancer.update_load()
